title: [MẪU] The first harvest in xứ Đông
excerpt: [MẪU] The whole family goes to the field at dawn to cut the first golden-flower rice of the season.
bodyHtml:
[MẪU] At dawn the family walks to the field while dew still sits on the leaves. The golden-flower ears are ripe and heavy.

[MẪU] Cut by hand

[MẪU] Each bundle is cut and tied by hand so the grains are not bruised. It is slow, but it keeps the quality.

  • [MẪU] Cut in gentle sun
  • [MẪU] Dry for two sunny days

title: [MẪU] How to cook soft, fragrant sticky rice
excerpt: [MẪU] Three simple steps for a soft, fragrant and evenly cooked pot.
bodyHtml:
[MẪU] Good sticky rice starts with soaking the grains long enough. These are the three steps the family follows every day.

[MẪU] The steps

  1. [MẪU] Soak 6 to 8 hours
  2. [MẪU] Drain the water
  3. [MẪU] Steam for about 30 minutes
[MẪU] Soft rice comes from good grains and enough soaking time.

[MẪU] More in the sample recipe page.

title: [MẪU] Storing sticky rice the right way
excerpt: [MẪU] A few small notes that keep the rice fragrant for longer.
bodyHtml:
[MẪU] Keep sticky rice in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight.

[MẪU] Full article address: https://example.com/stories/storing-sticky-rice/complete-guide-for-every-family/xu-dong-hai-duong/edition-2026-february

[MẪU] A small tip

[MẪU] Use a sealed jar and do not keep it near damp places.

title: [MẪU] Chuyện nhà Nếp ở xứ Đông
excerpt: [MẪU] Vì sao một gia đình chọn giữ nghề trồng nếp qua nhiều năm.
bodyHtml:
[MẪU] Nhà Nếp ở xứ Đông giữ nghề trồng nếp từ đời ông bà. Mỗi mùa gặt là một dịp để cả nhà gặp nhau.

[MẪU] Câu chuyện này chưa có bản tiếng Anh riêng, nên trang tiếng Anh dùng bản tiếng Việt.
